verdicts.proof: Old rule exists: ride_detail_screen.dart:260-268 computes the recording warning, :294 calls discardCurrent before deleteUserRide (:295). v2 RideDetailViewV2 gets onDelete: _delete (ride_detail_screen.dart:326) and wires it only into the header (ride_detail_view_v2.dart:83). The dialog branches inside the same _delete (:271-272, rideConfirmDeleteV2 body = warn ?? ride.name, ride_dialogs_v2.dart:11-20). grep deleteUserRide: the only other caller is trip delete-all (ride_trip_api.dart:197), which also detaches the recorder (:191-194), a different surface. No other v2 entry point deletes a single ride.

ride_detail_screen.dart:295-300: when deleted is false, _saveFailed(_delete, delete:true) (:204-207 showErrorSnack with retry) and returns without leaving. v2 uses the same _delete (:326). Only entry point is the v2 header delete (ride_detail_view_v2.dart:83).

Old: map onMapTap:_addStop / onPointTap (ride_detail_screen.dart:489-490), handlers :305-314 -> showRidePointSheet. v2: onMapTap:_addStop, onPointTap, onEditPoint:_editPoint (:327-329) -> RideTrackMap onMapTap/onPointTap (ride_detail_view_v2.dart:110-111) and RidePointCardV2 onTap (:150). Every v2 path calls the same old handler, which opens the same sheet. The server checks (save_ride_point) stay unchanged.

Old (ride_trip_row.dart is new on this branch; it is the current old look): _remove has the _busy guard (:36-44) and the button is disabled while busy (:108, onPressed: _busy ? null : _remove). Add-to-trip is shown only if rideTripsAvailable (:52). v2 RideTripRowV2 (shown at ride_detail_view_v2.dart:125): remove() (ride_trip_row_v2.dart:42-50) has no busy flag, and MgBtnText (:97) has no busy/disabled state (mg_buttons.dart MgBtnText takes only onTap). So repeated taps send several set_user_rides_trip calls and show several toasts. Add-to-trip gating holds and is stricter (:101 needs me.serverV2 && rideTripsAvailable). v2 also hides Remove when !me.serverV2 (:94), so there it is stricter. The v2 call also drops bookingIds (tripApplyV2 at trip_actions_v2.dart:31-34 vs old rideTripApply(..., bookingIds:[r.bookingId]) :40), so the booking ride lists are not refreshed. That is a refresh difference, not a lost guard.
verdicts.fix_idea: Make RideTripRowV2 a ConsumerStatefulWidget with a _busy flag: return early in remove() while busy, set and clear it around tripApplyV2, and pass onTap: busy ? null : remove (with a dimmed or spinner look) to the MgBtnText. Optionally pass bookingIds:[me.bookingId] the same way as the old row.

verdicts.proof: enableDrag:false lives in the shared showRidePointSheet (ride_point_sheet.dart:33). PopScope canPop: !_dirty && !_busy, with onPop -> _close (:199-205), wraps _buildSheet, which returns the v2 view (:210-226). So system back and the back gesture go through the same guard in v2. The v2 X button = MgV2Back(onTap: onClose) (ride_point_sheet_v2.dart:83) = _close (:221), which returns while busy (:104) and calls confirmDiscard when dirty (:105). confirmDiscard renders v2DiscardDialogLook with the same Stay=false / Discard=true results (error_feedback.dart:210-211, legacy_dialog_looks.dart:44-53). No other close path exists in the v2 view.

Old: _maxPhotos=8 (:83), _pick takes only free slots (:110-117), add tile only while count < max (:373). v2: maxPhotos:_maxPhotos (:219), the add tile only if count < maxPhotos (ride_point_sheet_v2.dart:118) with onPick=_pick (:223). v2 also shows an 'n / 8' counter (:104), which is clearer than the old look (silent).

_pick catch sets _error from FriendlyError perm photos (ride_point_sheet.dart:120-126). The v2 view gets error:_error (:214) and shows it as MgStateBanner tone err (ride_point_sheet_v2.dart:85-88), which is more visible than the old red 12px text (:267-271).

_save (ride_point_sheet.dart:132-181): if id is null it keeps the sheet open with eoRidePointSaveFail + eoTextKept (:163-168). Photos that did not upload are reported (:172-177). _savedId is reused (:153,170). v2 onSave:_save (:222) is the only save entry point (ride_point_sheet_v2.dart:141). The error appears as an err banner (:85-88). The server check save_ride_point is unchanged.

Old: onPressed: _busy ? null : _save with a spinner (ride_point_sheet.dart:287,295-300), and _save also returns early if _busy (:133). v2: MgBtnInk(busy: busy, onTap: busy ? null : onSave) (ride_point_sheet_v2.dart:141). MgBtnInk passes busy to _MgButton (mg_buttons.dart:102-123).

Old: the trash is shown only if widget.point != null (:249-258), and _delete returns if p==null||_busy (:185). There is no confirmation in either look. On failure the sheet stays open with eoRidePointDeleteFail (:190-192). v2: onDelete is passed only for an existing point (:220), the trash renders only when onDelete != null, and its onTap is null while busy (ride_point_sheet_v2.dart:71-81). It calls the same _delete.

Upload only when uid != null (ride_point_sheet.dart:138-140), inside the shared _save, which v2 reaches through onSave (:222). This behaves the same in both looks. A signed-out customer cannot normally reach My rides anyway. Storage policy media_ride_upload is server-side.

ride_share.dart:48-51 _shareLink uses rideShareWaypoints and gives an empty link when there are fewer than 2 points. showRideShareSheet computes body and link before branching to v2 (:120-125). The v2 ride detail share = onShare: showRideShareSheet (ride_detail_screen.dart:325). v2 trip share (trip_detail_screen_v2.dart:154-170) uses the same rideShareWaypoints and the same pts.length >= 2 rule. Its text is built separately but leaves the link out the same way.
